# Introduction

This document follows the same workflow for analyzing urban phenology data, while changing the climate variable to the Daymet instead. The analysis is structured around two main levels: genus and species, with a particular emphasis on the city of New York.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| include: false
#| warning: false

# Install and load 'zhulabtools' package
library(zhulabtools)

# Manage packages: check, install, and load specific packages

phe_types <- c("SOS", "EOS")
```

```{r}
#| include: false
generate_mcmc_plot <- function(dir_path) {
  
  # Helper to process files by pattern
  process_files <- function(file_list, phe_type_label) {
    param_list <- map(file_list, function(file) {
      model_data <- readRDS(file)
      genus <- sub(paste0("(.*?)_", phe_type_label, "\\.rds"), "\\1", basename(file))
      beta_label <- data.frame(Parameter = "beta[2]", Label = genus)
      param_data <- ggs(model_data$samples, par_labels = beta_label) %>%
        filter(Parameter == genus)
      return(param_data)
    })
    combined_param_data <- bind_rows(param_list) %>%
      filter(Parameter != "Alnus") %>%
      mutate(phe_type = phe_type_label)
    return(combined_param_data)
  }
  
  # Collect files
  SOS_files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "SOS\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
  EOS_files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "EOS\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
  Gup_files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "GreenUp\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
  Gdown_files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "GreenDown\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  # Process each type
  sos_data <- process_files(SOS_files, "SOS")
  eos_data <- process_files(EOS_files, "EOS")
  gup_data <- process_files(Gup_files, "GreenUp")
  gdown_data <- process_files(Gdown_files, "GreenDown")
  
  combined_param_data <- bind_rows(sos_data, eos_data, gup_data, gdown_data)
  
  # Summarize
  summary_data <- combined_param_data %>%
    group_by(Parameter, phe_type) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower_2_5 = quantile(value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      upper_97_5 = quantile(value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Sig = ifelse(lower_2_5 * upper_97_5 > 0, "*", ""),
           SigAlpha = ifelse(Sig == "*", 1, 0.2))
  
  summary_data$phe_type <- factor(summary_data$phe_type, levels = c("SOS", "EOS", "GreenUp", "GreenDown"))
  param_levels <- rev(unique(summary_data$Parameter))
  
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = factor(Parameter, levels = param_levels), y = mean_value)) +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = SigAlpha), size=3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_2_5, ymax = upper_97_5, alpha = SigAlpha), width = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_value, 3)), 
            vjust = -0.7, size = 4) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  guides(alpha = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ phe_type, scales = "free_x") +  # flip x/y means free_x
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Estimate") +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14)
  ) +
    coord_flip()
  
  return(p)
}

source("~/phenology-urban/script/spatial_stats_model/run_genus_inla_fixpre.R")
source("~/phenology-urban/script/spatial_stats_model/run_species_inla.R")
```

# Spatial Model

## INLA

```{r data-3}
#| eval: false
#| include: false
city <- "NY"

## prepare input data
metadata <- read_csv("~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/PS/urban/metadata.csv") %>%
  filter(site == !!city)
file_list <- list.files(path = "~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/PS/urban/doy", pattern = paste0("^doy_",city,"_.*\\.rds$"), full.names = TRUE)
data_list <- file_list %>%
  map(~ readRDS(.x))
all_doy <- bind_rows(data_list)
tree_location <- metadata %>%
  mutate(genus = str_extract(taxa, "^[^ ]+")) %>%
  left_join(all_doy, by = "id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(doy)) %>%
  mutate(geometry = paste0("c(", lon, ", ", lat, ")"))

# List of Humid variable names and their corresponding filenames
files <- c("temp_monthly_all_tree.rds",
           "srad_monthly_all_tree.rds")
base_path <- "~/phenology-urban/data/raw/"
processed_humid_list <- lapply(files, function(file_name) {
  # Read the file
  var_name <- sub("_monthly_all_tree.rds", "", file_name)
  data <- readRDS(paste0(base_path, city, "/HUMID/", file_name)) %>%
    select(id, value, date) %>%
    mutate(
      season = case_when(
        substr(date, 6, 7) %in% c("03", "04", "05") ~ "spring",
        substr(date, 6, 7) %in% c("06", "07", "08") ~ "summer",
        substr(date, 6, 7) %in% c("09", "10", "11") ~ "fall",
        substr(date, 6, 7) %in% c("12", "01", "02") ~ "winter"
      )) %>%
    mutate(year = as.integer(substr(date, 1, 4)),
           year = if_else(substr(date, 6, 7) == "12", year + 1, year)) %>%
    filter(year < 2019) %>% 
    group_by(id, year, season) %>%
    summarise(
    # Use sum for prcp, and mean for temp and srad
    Avg_value = mean(as.numeric(value), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Rename the Avg_value column to the variable name (e.g., tmax, tmin, prcp)
  rename(!!var_name := Avg_value)
  return(data)
})

files <- c("prcp_monthly_all_tree.rds")
processed_daymet_list <- lapply(files, function(file_name) {
  # Read the file
  var_name <- sub("_monthly_all_tree.rds", "", file_name)
  data <- readRDS(paste0(base_path, city, "/Daymet/monthly2016-2024/", file_name)) %>%
    select(id, value, date) %>%
    mutate(
      season = case_when(
        substr(date, 6, 7) %in% c("03", "04", "05") ~ "spring",
        substr(date, 6, 7) %in% c("06", "07", "08") ~ "summer",
        substr(date, 6, 7) %in% c("09", "10", "11") ~ "fall",
        substr(date, 6, 7) %in% c("12", "01", "02") ~ "winter"
      )) %>%
    mutate(year = as.integer(substr(date, 1, 4)),
           year = if_else(substr(date, 6, 7) == "12", year + 1, year)) %>%
    group_by(id, year, season) %>%
    summarise(
    # Use sum for prcp, and mean for temp and srad
    Avg_value = sum(as.numeric(value), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Rename the Avg_value column to the variable name (e.g., tmax, tmin, prcp)
  rename(!!var_name := Avg_value)

  return(data)
})

all_sites_climate <- processed_humid_list[[1]] |>
  left_join(processed_daymet_list[[1]], by = c("id", "season", "year")) 

srad_daily <- processed_humid_list[[2]] |>
  rename(Avg_srad = srad)
```

# Diagnostic

## The spatial confounding between fixed effects and spatial random effects

```{r}
model <- readRDS("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/urban/sp_model/fixed_preseason/inla_year_random_genus_check/NY/Acer_SOS.rds")
spatial_mean <- model$res$summary.random$spatial.field$mean
A_full <- inla.stack.A(model$stk.full)
A_spatial <- A_full[["2"]]

A_est <- A_spatial[inla.stack.index(model$stk.full, tag = "est")$data, ]
```
